critique: The background is a solid color, lacking any visual interest or depth, making the frame feel empty.
The HUD elements are somewhat readable, but the health and score text could benefit from better contrast against the background.
There is no indication of player or enemy presence, making it unclear what the current gameplay situation is.
priorityFixes: Introduce a more dynamic background to reduce the feeling of emptiness.
Enhance the contrast of the HUD elements by using a brighter color or adding outlines to improve readability.
Add visual indicators for player actions or enemy presence to enhance engagement and clarity.
